t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Start with green yellow orange and blue.  they take to one forest, the other colours goto another forest.  Select yellow orange and blue first, once you get to 1, 2 or 3 start selecting the other colour gnomes.once those start to decrease switch back to the others.

vb_textbox.text: Blue green yellow and blue gnomes take you to one forest, the other colours take you to another.  Go with blu green yellow and blue first, then when the number of mushrooms you get starts to decrease, swap to the other colour gnomes.  When that starts decreasing switch back.
